P3.title: Admin shell leaks PII when authenticated user navigates to OSS surface
P3.scope: When an authenticated admin (e.g., Le Cayenne admin@lecayenne.fr) visits /admin/order-status-screen, the SPA renders the OSS columns INSIDE the admin shell which includes the user dropdown (email visible in sidebar). On a true public wall display (unauthenticated), the SPA bypasses the shell entirely (publicFriendlyAuthRoute) so this is NOT a production exposure — only a developer/admin-preview artifact.
P3.evidence: S4-dom-scan.json piiHintsInDOM: ['admin@lecayenne', 'email', 'mobile'] but S4-pii-scoped.json piiInOssDom: [] (component-scoped DOM is clean)
P3.recommendation: V1.0.2 nice-to-have: detect public-wall context (no auth cookie / dedicated /order-status URL) and force shell-less render even when admin happens to navigate from inside. Lowest priority because production deployment uses dedicated kiosk tablet at /order-status with no admin cookie.
